read_only: This device can't offload or restore what is on a computer's disk.

confirmation_required: Confirm first: nothing has been moved.

refused: {name} refused some items. Nothing has been moved.
deadline: {name} took too long to answer. Try again.
bad_answer: {name} gave an answer Persona can't use.
refusal_not_regular: It isn't a regular file or folder.
refusal_symlink: It is a link to something else.
refusal_outside_home: It is outside your home folder.
refusal_home_root: It is your home folder itself.
